items.title: Kroger, Dollar Tree, and Grocery Outlet Shares Are Falling, What You Need To Know

items.title: Why Kohl's (KSS) Shares Are Plunging Today
items.summary: Shares of department store chain Kohl’s (NYSE:KSS) fell 5% in the afternoon session after several other major retailers reported disappointing results and outlooks, signaling widespread weakness in consumer spending. The negative sentiment was sparked by grocery chain Albertsons, which cut its annual sales and profit forecasts, citing the need to compete for cash-strapped shoppers.
